verdict.rationale: Signifyd's own site lists an Account Protection product ('Defend customer accounts') and Return Insights for returns, so it has first-party offerings beyond checkout. The only support is those one-line marketing taglines; the API docs cover only checkout, sale, chargeback and decision flows. missing for 10: documented account takeover scoring (login/account events), fake account creation detection, promo abuse scoring, evidence that these are scored and managed in the same decision system as checkout, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a risk analyst, protection extends beyond checkout — account takeover, fake account creation, promo and policy abuse are scored and managed in the same system

citations.quote: Account Protection Defend customer accounts, inspire customer loyalty
Return Insights Actionable intelligence to reduce returns and protect revenue
